# Chrome Web Store

> Chrome Web Store is Google's marketplace for Chrome extensions and applications, featuring productivity tools, educational integrations, developer utilities, and privacy-focused extensions.

The Chrome Web Store hosts thousands of extensions that enhance browser functionality across education, development, content creation, and privacy domains. Extensions range from classroom management tools to advanced web scraping utilities and ad blockers.

## Key Topics

- Chrome Extension
- Chrome Web Store
- Google Classroom
- Education Tools
- Web Scraping
- AI-Powered Extensions
- Data Extraction
- Ad Blocker
- Privacy Tools
- Teacher Tools
- Web Content Sharing
- Developer Tools
- No-Code Solutions
- Video Downloader
- Change Detection

## Education & Classroom Tools

- [Add to Google Classroom](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/add-to-google-classroom/oaobmlmjmhedmlphfdmdjpppjmcljnkp?ucbcb=1): Chrome extension for sharing web content directly to Google Classroom, streamlining educator workflows

## Data & Web Tools

- [Agenty - Advanced Web Scraper](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/agenty-advanced-web-scrap/gpolcofcjjiooogejfbaamdgmgfehgff?ucbcb=1): AI-powered web scraping extension for automated data extraction and web crawling without coding

## Privacy & Security

- [uBlock Origin](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/ublock-origin/cjpalhdlnbpafiamejdnhcphjbkeiagm?hl=en;): Efficient open-source ad blocker and privacy extension for Chrome with minimal resource usage

## Optional Extensions

- [FACEIT Predictor](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/faceit-predictor/plbhidhbocjfalcpofamaklaeecpplkd?hlzh-CN&ucbcb=1): AI-powered Chrome extension predicting FACEIT esports match outcomes for competitive gaming
- [Snaptik - TikTok Video Downloader](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/snaptik-tiktok-video-down/bahblebldjmacmpdllhinebpfbdpcdnl?Hl=ru): TikTok video downloader extension with watermark removal capability for content creators
